title: HOW TO #12: Build a Car That Drives On Ice
caption:
How to build a car that drives on ice 🚗🧊

A car, an ice lake and a 100 kg limit. 10 problems, 10 fixes: studded wheels, a parachute brake, wider tires, a blanket on the hood, a heater against fog, a visor against glare, a pole and skis for the gap. A car that crosses at 60 km/h.

Would you drive it or trust the ice? Comment ICE below. Tag the friend who drives too fast. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #13!
